I am 64 years old and I have farmed these 10.1 mu in Quzhou County for 40 years. I finished middle school, so I can read a fertilizer bag and figure my costs, but the field is where I really learned. Last year I grew improved Bt cotton on the whole farm and harvested about 280 kg of seed cotton per mu, so this year I will do the exact same thing — I only change when I see a neighbor do better with my own eyes. I buy improved Bt cotton seeds at about 80 yuan per mu because they keep the bollworm down. For fertilizer, I put down one 50 kg bag of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu as base fertilizer before planting, then I have the neighbor's son run the rotary tiller to mix it in. That gives me 7.5 kg each of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium right away. Then I top-dress with half a bag of urea — 25 kg per mu — split into 15 kg when the first flowers open and 10 kg when the bolls are setting. That urea adds 11.5 kg of nitrogen, so in total I use 19 kg of nitrogen per mu. I know that is on the generous side, but I would rather waste some fertilizer than lose yield. A bad harvest is a disaster for two people living on one farm; extra fertilizer is just money spent. I irrigate four times from my well: right after planting in late April, once in mid-June when the heat comes, once in mid-July at peak flowering, and once in early August to plump the bolls. Each time I run the diesel pump for half a morning. I spray pesticide five times because even Bt cotton gets aphids and spider mites. I hire the drone service at 8 yuan per mu per spray — 40 yuan per mu total — because carrying a tank on my back at 64 is finished. I do rotary tillage once before planting, paying 50 yuan per mu to the neighbor with the machine. I expect 280 kg per mu of seed cotton this year if the weather holds. My wife and I will pick some, but I will hire two local workers at 2 yuan per kilogram for the bulk of the harvest. I think about the whole budget — seeds, fertilizer, diesel, spray, tillage, and picking labor — so I stick to what worked last year and watch what everyone else is doing.
